title: Erez Komarovsky's Sabich
subtitle: with charred eggplant, soft eggs, zhug and almond tahini
description: A sabich plate with fire-charred eggplant instead of fried, soft-boiled eggs, a fresh green zhug and almond tahini, served with thick pita.

steps.text: Make the zhug (ideally ahead): pound the deseeded green chillies, coriander and garlic in a mortar and pestle (or chop very finely with a sharp knife) and mix with the olive oil. Store in a glass jar.
Char the eggplants over an open flame until soft and the skin is blackened. Peel them but keep them whole.
Boil the eggs in boiling water for about 4 minutes until soft-set, then peel carefully.
Arrange the eggplants on 4 plates, top with the eggs and spoon over plenty of zhug.
Drizzle with lemon juice, sprinkle with coarse salt and drizzle with almond tahini. Serve with pita.
